CALL TO ORDER

At 5:02 PM, Chair McGuan called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, Grisafe, McGuan

Also present: Christopher Koontz, Director of Community Development, Erin Weesner-McKinley,
Principal Deputy City Attorney, Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Alejandro Sanchez-
Lopez, Advanced Planning Officer, Alejandro Plascencia, Planner, Felice Anaya, Clerk Typist,
Alyssa Campos, City Clerk Specialist.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

Chair McGuan led the Pledge of Allegiance.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Hunter, seconded by Vice Chair
  Grisafe, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following
  vote:

  Yes:  7  Bodek, Hunter, Padilla-Perez, Pizzo, Pryor, Grisafe, McGuan
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  Alison Spindler-Ruiz, Planning Bureau Manager, Community Development,
  spoke; and provided the Director’s Report.
